defs.net: NetRtg: points scored minus allowed per 100 possessions. The adjusted version (used for the model) takes out home court and the strength of the opponents played, like Basketball-Reference's NRtg/A.
defs.efg: Effective FG%: field goals with threes counted 1.5×.
defs.orbp: Offensive rebound %: share of own missed shots rebounded.
defs.ftr: Free throw rate: free throw attempts per field goal attempt.
defs.splits: season; l5 / l10 = last 5 / 10 games; home / away; last = last season.
defs.players: Key players: the 5 who started most of the team's last 5 games, plus up to 4 bench players averaging 14+ minutes lately (or 20+ on the season).
defs.inj: Injuries come from the injury report the scheduled run read.
defs.stars: Stars: a team's top two scorers averaging 18+ points.
defs.prior: His 3P% gets pulled toward last season's 3P%, itself pulled toward league average over 300 attempts.
